== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sacred artists are practitioners of the [[sacred arts]], a discipline centered on controlling [[aura]] and [[madra]] to manipulate nature or execute specialized techniques. These individuals follow various [[Paths]], such as those involving earth, [[water]], force, or [[blood]] and swords, with some even imitating the powers of [[Black dragons|black dragons]]. While many are dedicated to combat, others serve as teachers, messengers, or artists. Their progression through [[advancement]] stages—ranging from [[Iron]] and [[Copper]] to [[Jade]], [[Gold]], [[Lord]], and beyond—is a central aspect of their lives. Highly advanced practitioners often possess immense power, capable of overwhelming others or even trading blows with [[Dreadgods]]. Socially, sacred artists are often defined by their clan or sect affiliations, which dictate their attire and reputation. They frequently value their personal and familial honor above their own lives, sometimes viewing combat against those of a lower stage as shameful. In many cultures, there is an ingrained social hierarchy where lower-level artists instinctively defer to those of higher [[advancement]]. Beyond combat, some sacred artists possess skills in [[Soulsmithing]], a specialized craft used to create weapons and spiritual [[constructs]]. The pursuit of the [[sacred arts]] is driven by diverse motivations, including the desire for [[advancement]], protection, or personal resolve.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Sacred artists serve as powerful warriors who can be found patrolling the streets or standing guard before low walls. To avoid weakness, these individuals must maintain a willingness to face risk and engage in combat. They approach their development by preparing thoroughly for each stage of their progression. Furthermore, the manuals detailing [[Lindon]]'s [[Path]] possess the potential to serve as guides for these young practitioners.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[sacred artists|Sacred artists]] are powerful warriors standing in front of a low wall.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c5">''Soulsmith'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[sacred artists|Sacred artists]] are present in the street.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9">''Soulsmith'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Clad in black-and-red robes, the sacred artists of [[Redmoon Hall]] emerged from a void [[portal]]. They appeared through various doors and windows, each individual shining with a [[white halo]]. While these artists possess the ability to surround a [[labyrinth]] exit using their perceptions, they remain vulnerable to having their [[willpower]] compromised by specific experiences.}}
